title: Valar Atomics model card
description: A big black card with 8px corners on the page grey, 85% of the window tall on desktop: the heading on the left half, a paragraph and a gold-framed button on the right, over a picture that fills the card beneath a black fade from the top. As the card enters, the picture rises 75px, shrinks from 1.05 to 1 and fades in.
notes: the card is a `dark` scope: black on a light page, with a faint hairline so it still reads on a black page
the settle-in is a CSS view timeline (no JS); phones leave ~400px of picture below the text
name: valaratomics-model
